issues.description: Replaced an undefined dressing and fryer method with measured rice-vinegar dressing and stovetop poaching to 74°C; yield and 300 g chicken now match two portions. Text review covered all four locale bodies. Recipe timing, yield, and sensory outcome remain unverified because no kitchen trial was performed; no trial evidence or restaurant provenance is claimed.
issues.suggested_fix: Have a cook prepare the recipe as written, record actual prep and cook time and yield, confirm texture and applicable safe internal temperatures, then update the article before reconsidering indexing.
